description: User asks the coding agent to build from a saved planner package that is ready for implementation.
why_this_matters: Verifies the main path: validate handoff, execute plan steps in order, apply each step acceptance criteria, run final acceptance, pass the requirement-test coverage gate, and write completion artifacts without requiring an external review loop.

input.user_prompt:
Build requirements/ECCS-12837/plan/plan.md
Go through it step by step and apply each step acceptance criteria in the agent loop.
input.context: handoff.json has status READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION, requiresHumanAck false, nextAction run_coding_agent, skeletonReviewRequired false, skeletonReviewApproved null, solutionSkeletonSpecUrl null, and null execution-result fields.

should_not_contain: wrote completion-report.md before the coverage gate
